Vodafone Idea.subject: Telecom & Postal
Vodafone Idea.question: As of _____, 2026, Vi has a subscriber base of 198.82 million, making it third largest mobile telecommunications network in India and 12th largest mobile telecommunications network in the world
Vodafone Idea.fact: As of July, 2026, Vi has a subscriber base of 198.82 million, making it third largest mobile telecommunications network in India and 12th largest mobile telecommunications network in the world. The merger got approval from the Department of Telecommunications in July 2018.
